name: Mucken
summary: Team-based trick-taking variant of Schafkopf played by 2-vs-2 (or 3-vs-3) partnerships in Franconia.
rules_text: Mucken is played with 24 Bavarian cards (30 points per suit, 120 total). Players sit so partners face each other; in 6-player games teams form a V-shape with no teammates adjacent. Dealer shuffles, right player cuts at least 3 cards or knocks to change dealing, then deals two packets of three clockwise, 6 cards each, 6 tricks. Auction clockwise from forehand: bid Play or Pass, higher contract overcalls lower (common order Wenz < Geier < Muck < Schneider < Schwarz/Tout). Wenz trumps are four Unters, Geier four Obers, Muck Obers+Unters+Hearts (or chosen suit). After announcement, opening player left of dealer leads, clockwise follow. Must follow suit if able (Farbzwang), no Stichzwang or Trumpfzwang. Trump beats suit, higher trump beats lower. Highest card of led suit or highest trump wins trick and leads next. Need 61 points to win, 91 for schneider, all tricks for schwarz; if schneider/schwarz declared defender needs only 30 points / one trick. Defenders may call Kontra then Re, Sup, Hirsch each doubling game value before first card. Only winning team scores toward a match target usually 21 points; first to target wins the Bobbl/Hänger.
rating_reason: Team trick-taking Schafkopf variant, hidden hands, strategic
